fields.description: Which artwork version this step judged. Required: "approved" without saying what was approved is how the wrong artwork reaches the print shop (SIG-003).
fields.label: Design

fields.description: SIG-002's order: Content Verification, then Approval, then Print Proof, then Production, then Installation. A step may only pass once every step before it has passed or been waived for this same design.
fields.label: Step
fields.options:
Content Verification
Approval
Print Proof
Production
Installation

fields.description: A step dated before the step it depends on is refused — the order is chronological, not merely a matter of which rows exist.
fields.label: Occurred On

fields.description: Waived is an authorised exception and clears the gate the way a pass does; it stays in the trail carrying its reason, which is why the note is mandatory on anything but a pass.
fields.label: Outcome

fields.description: Required on Failed and on Waived. A failure or a waiver with no reason is indistinguishable from a step nobody did.
fields.label: Note
